# T389 — Is the place-cell code generated by recurrent attractor dynamics, or is it a feedforward conjunction that only looks like one?

**Status:** `LIVE`  
**Level:** `L2`  
**Registry:** [[wiki/empirical-tensions.md]]  
**Closes when:** The invariance criterion (C3, [[wiki/concepts/attractor-identification.md]]) is run on a place-cell population *within* one environment across the removal of tuned input — sleep or darkness — at population scale, so that "cell–cell structure is not preserved" is separated into "there is no attractor" versus "there is one attractor per map and remapping switches between them"; or a model reproduces remapping and CA3 replay with a stated division of labour between the feedforward and recurrent contributions.

## Position A

**Recurrent attractor, one chart per environment.** CA3's recurrent collaterals stabilise a continuous attractor whose states tile an environment; multiple uncorrelated charts coexist in the same weights, and continuous and discrete patterns can be stored together and retrieved from each other ([[wiki/entities/rolls-treves-hippocampal-model.md]]). Place fields persist in the dark and shortly into sleep, the within-environment population response lies on a low-dimensional manifold, and the sequential reactivation of past trajectories during replay is attributed to exactly those recurrent connections ([[wiki/concepts/offline-replay.md]])

## Position B

**Feedforward conjunction of upstream codes.** Storing several high-resolution maps in a homogeneous attractor network severely limits capacity, and the defining attractor prediction fails where it has been tested: place-cell cell–cell correlations are *not* preserved across environments (remapping) nor across sleep, while co-modular grid-cell relationships are preserved across both in the same recordings. Place tuning is then better read as a conjunction over feedforward inputs — grid, border, landmark and reward-site cells — with the low dimensionality inherited from those inputs rather than imposed by recurrence (Khona & Fiete 2022)

## Where it bites

Whether the wiki's fast store is allowed to be modelled as a recurrent chart at all. Position A is the premise of every continuous-attractor hippocampal model here and of the "completion = relaxation" reading of [[wiki/concepts/pattern-separation-completion.md]]; Position B makes the hippocampal layer a *binding* stage with no dynamics of its own, which moves de-aliasing entirely upstream into the structural code and leaves replay as the only phenomenon needing recurrence. The capacity half is decisive for a builder: under A, adding environments costs interference in one weight matrix and is bounded by `p_max` (`G42`); under B, adding environments costs nothing in the hippocampal layer because nothing is stored there.

**A second, independent line for Position B, and it is a manipulation rather than an invariance test** (Colgin et al. 2010). Whether the hippocampal population shows attractor dynamics at all is set by what the *upstream* path integrator was given: rats that could walk between a square and a circle, and so assigned them different coordinates, later switched abruptly and coherently between two orthogonal maps across a shape morph (CA3 square-vs-circle population-vector correlation `0.03 ± 0.11`), while rats shown the same two shapes at one location only changed firing rates, linearly, with field locations fixed. Associating the environments' features with each other — the operation Position A's recurrent collaterals are supposed to perform — was available in both arms and produced nothing. Two qualifications keep it from closing the row: the steepest transitions were in CA1, which has no recurrence to speak of, so the experiment localises the landscape *upstream of the hippocampus proper* without saying whether CA3 also has one; and it says nothing about replay, which remains Position A's unanswered evidence. The authors' own proposal for CA3 in the absence of feature autoassociation is Position-B-compatible — recurrent collaterals generating **phase sequences** of place codes (route encoding, index-code sequences for cortical recall) rather than storing feature conjunctions.

The review stating Position B concedes the replay point and proposes collaboration — feedforward tuning plus recurrent sequence generation — which is not yet a model with a division of labour, and would predict that the two functions dissociate under a manipulation that spares one.

## Status

`LIVE`

**Sibling rows:** `T40` asks what a place *cell* is (conjunction of `g̃ ⊙ x̃` versus a memory-index neuron) and is agnostic about whether the population has autonomous dynamics; this row asks whether the population's states are internally generated, and both of `T40`'s positions are compatible with Position B here. `T49` supplies the contested CA3 connectivity number that Position A's capacity estimate depends on.
